label: PowerBelly coupling (BARA_LESSONS section 6 E item 2)
semantics: One Belly control whose character changes with the Muscle vector, as coupling terms, not a mode switch. core_share = muscle x belly_composite is the share of the belly field the geometry layer routes through the built-core variant (low-sitting, tilt-coupled, chest ring dominant); drape_share = 1 - core_share routes through the v4 fat-drape system. tilt_deg scales the v4 posture shear's pelvic lobe with core_share (anchor: v4's -3.0 deg lobe at full core share). Advisories flag the two failure reads: belly out-sliding chest at lifter muscle levels (check M4 chest:waist >= 1.28 on the mesh), and a big belly with no core under it (the Fat Males read, BARA_LESSONS R18).
